notes: The contents (حُسنِ ترتیب) is arranged in four sections: حصّہ حمد و نعت (items 1-2), حصّہ نثر (3-12), حصّہ نظم (13-16), حصّہ غزل (17-20). The numbering is a single running sequence across sections; the columns give عنوان (title) and شاعر/مصنّف (poet/author), which are not reproduced here. Front/back matter listed after item 20 (فرہنگ p.150, سوالیہ پرچے کی تیاری بارے ہدایات p.157, ماڈل سوالیہ پرچہ p.158) has been omitted per instructions. Ghazal titles are the first lines as printed.
